scope_policy.references: All explicit links in the two source documents, plus named works that materially support their argument and were found by the full-text audit.
scope_policy.repositories: Source snapshots are limited to repositories directly presented as code, data, experiment artifacts, or named infrastructure for the referenced work. Bibliography-only URLs, generic dependencies, third-party reimplementations, and publication-site infrastructure repositories are catalogued but not mirrored.
scope_policy.integrity: Every local artifact is recorded with byte size and SHA-256. Git repositories are codeload tar.gz snapshots at immutable commits and contain no .git directory.
scope_policy.access: No authentication, paywall bypass, or challenge bypass was attempted.
